components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action for an available operator task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10.4px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--brand); border-radius: 0; background: var(--brand); color: #fff; font: 700 12px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.88); } .ds-button-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.75); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: revert; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10.4px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 700 12px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(0.88); } .ds-button-secondary:active { filter: brightness(0.75); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: revert; }

components.name: Important Button
components.css: .ds-button-important { min-height: 42px; padding: 10.4px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--red); border-radius: 0; background: var(--red); color: #fff; font: 700 12px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-important:hover { filter: brightness(0.88); } .ds-button-important:active { filter: brightness(0.75); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-button-important:focus-visible { outline: revert; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Square, full-width field for team and terrain entry.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" value="North Field" aria-label="Terrain name">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 400 14px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: revert; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Operator Navigation
components.description: Compact links between the operator and public display.
components.html: OPERATOROPEN SUMMARY
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; color: var(--text); font: 700 11px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--navy); border-color: var(--navy) !important; color: #fff !important; } .ds-nav-link { background: var(--surface); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--bg); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: revert; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat bordered surface grouping operator content.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--navy); font: 700 24px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font: 400 16px/1.45 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Rectangular, explicit status label for a match or round.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--brand); border-radius: 0; background: rgba(0, 94, 255, 0.1); color: var(--brand); font: 700 11px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Current Round Card
components.description: Operator round container with its state halo and collapsible heading.
components.css: .ds-round-card { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); } .ds-round-card[open] { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 94, 255, 0.15); } .ds-round-card summary { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; color: var(--navy); font: 700 18px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-round-card summary span { color: var(--brand); font: 700 11px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-round-card div { padding-top: 12px; }

components.name: Standings Signal Cells
components.description: Green backgrounds identify qualifiers; purple identifies best stat values.
components.css: .ds-standings { border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--text); font: 400 16px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-standings td { padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); print-color-adjust: exact; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; } .ds-standings td:first-child { text-align: center; } .ds-standings .ds-qualified { background: var(--qualified-bg); } .ds-standings .ds-best { background: var(--best-bg); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Public Scoreboard Header
components.description: Navy public display header with prominent mono round timer.
components.css: .ds-scoreboard { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 20px; background: var(--navy); color: #fff; } .ds-scoreboard strong { font: 800 56px/0.95 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-scoreboard .ds-clock { font: 700 64px/0.95 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-align: center; } .ds-scoreboard .ds-stage { justify-self: end; font: 700 18px Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
This is a practical event console, not a SaaS dashboard. The operator screen supports one organizer making quick, confident changes under live event pressure. A separate public screen presents the current round, standings, and knockout bracket so they can be read across a room.

The shared visual identity with race_lap_software is community-built and instrument-like: strong navy structure, square bordered surfaces, condensed headings, and monospace live data. Color is functional, and hierarchy comes from spacing, borders, and restrained status highlights rather than ornament. The app and its fonts are self-contained and work offline.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, scannable operator controls and a large-type public scoreboard
Barlow Condensed headings, Barlow interface text, and Roboto Mono live values
Square white surfaces on a pale page, with thin blue-grey borders
Color reserved for actions, status, qualification, and best-stat signals

rules.name: The Function-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Use color to signal action or state, never as decoration. State is also named in text; color alone does not carry meaning.

rules.name: The Standings Shading Rule
rules.body: Shade qualified rank/team cells green and best stat cells purple. Keep text readable, and preserve these backgrounds in print so the distinctions remain visible in grayscale.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Render scores and live/changing numbers in Roboto Mono; keep static labels in the Barlow families.

rules.name: The State-Halo Rule
rules.body: Keep blue halos limited to the current-round state; do not add shadows to ordinary cards or controls.

dos: Do keep the palette and font families aligned with the documented tokens.
Do use Barlow Condensed for display headings and Roboto Mono for live figures.
Do state ON/OFF and match status in text as well as color.
Do use green and purple cell backgrounds for qualification and best standings values, and preserve them in print.
Do reserve blue halos for the current round.
donts: Don't add gradients, decorative color, ambient card shadows, or rounded dashboard surfaces.
Don't use color as the only signal for an action or status.
Don't change the two-screen split: the operator page mutates tournament state; the public summary remains read-only.
Don't introduce remote fonts or assets; both pages must remain usable offline.
